sections.title: Pros
sections.narration: On the plus side: strong all-round legume profile. Fibre, minerals, and useful protein all show up well enough to make it a very solid category food. Easy to use across lots of meals. Works in bowls, curries, salads, hummus, and snacks. Pretty filling and steady. Useful as a practical staple rather than just a niche health food.

sections.title: Cons
sections.narration: Now the downsides: sugar is a bit high for the category. Not a disaster, but it is less clean than the best legumes on this axis. Can be rough on some people digestively. Legume tolerance varies a lot. Contains some anti-nutrients. Phytates may reduce mineral uptake somewhat.
